Class RoundsVisitor

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.visitor.rounds.RoundsVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ordered, Toggleable, TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
public class RoundsVisitor extends Object implements TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
Records the rounds of the classes of the package "registerbean", and registers a bean of RegisteredRecord for each of them from finishRound(VisitorContext), named after the round, and one from finish(VisitorContext), named finish. Visiting the class "registerbean.Trigger" generates the source of the class "registerbean.GeneratedLater", which the next round visits.

    • finishRound

      public void finishRound(VisitorContext context)
      Description copied from interface: TypeElementVisitor
      Called at the end of each processing round, after every visitor has visited every class of the round.

      A round is the set of classes a compiler hands to the visitors together. The classes of the compilation form the first round, and the classes generated as source during a round form the next one. When this method is called, no class of the round is visited anymore, and:

      • a bean added with VisitorContext.registerBean(ClassElement, io.micronaut.inject.ast.Element...) or ClassElement.addAssociatedBean(ClassElement) is written with the beans of the round;
      • a source written with ClassWriterOutputVisitor.visitGeneratedSourceFile(String, String, io.micronaut.inject.ast.Element...) is compiled, and its classes are visited in a later round, followed by another call of this method.

      The rounds of each compiler:

      • javac: each annotation processing round, except the final one, in which nothing generated is processed anymore. TypeElementVisitor.finish(VisitorContext) is called after this method in every round, the final one included.
      • KSP: each call of SymbolProcessor.process. TypeElementVisitor.finish(VisitorContext) is called once, after the last round.
      • Groovy: the classes of the compilation are a round, visited during canonicalization, and so is each set of classes generated as source afterwards. TypeElementVisitor.finish(VisitorContext) is called once, at class generation.
      • Python: the compilation is a single round.

      A round may visit no class matching this visitor, and the elements of a round are only guaranteed to be usable during that round: KSP invalidates them when the round ends.

      Specified by:
      finishRound in interface TypeElementVisitor<Object,Object>
      Parameters:
      context - The visitor context

    • finish

      public void finish(VisitorContext context)
      Description copied from interface: TypeElementVisitor
      Called when visitor processing finishes.

      Under KSP and Groovy, this method is called once, when nothing generated as source is compiled anymore. Under javac, it is called at the end of every annotation processing round, after TypeElementVisitor.finishRound(VisitorContext), the final round included. Prefer TypeElementVisitor.finishRound(VisitorContext) for work that has to be done once the classes of a round are visited: under KSP the elements of the rounds are invalid by the time this method is called, and no bean can be registered from it.

      Specified by:
